app_store.name: Byte Acres: Code a Farm
app_store.subtitle: Learn Python by farming
app_store.promotional_text: Write your first line of Python in under a minute. The start of the game is free, and the whole farm is one purchase.
app_store.description:
Learn to code by teaching a drone to farm.

Byte Acres is a cozy farming game you play by writing real Python, one idea at a time. Type harvest(), press Run, and watch your drone do exactly what you wrote. What you harvest pays for the next idea: loops, if, variables, functions, lists.

Made for people who are new to code:
- Every idea has a page in the field guide that explains it
- Errors mark the line and say what went wrong in plain words
- Use something you haven't unlocked yet, and the game tells you what to get
- Your code saves as you type
- Edit your program while the drone keeps working

Grow grass, bushes, trees and carrots, water your fields and expand your farm. More crops are on the way, each one a new kind of puzzle.

The start of the game is free. The whole farm is one purchase. No subscription.
app_store.whats_new: First release. Start with harvest() and grow from there.
